title: Settings, derived
hints: `Resolved<T>` is a mapped type over `keyof T` that adds `readonly` in front and removes `?` with `-?` after the brackets. `SettingsPatch` and `PublicSettings` are each one line of `Partial`, `Omit` and `Resolved` combined.

`resolve` fills each optional field with `??` and the matching `DEFAULTS` value. `applyPatch` must drop the patch's `undefined` values before spreading. `toPublic` can't rely on the type: pull `apiToken` out with destructuring, `const { apiToken, ...rest } = settings;`, and return `rest`.

type Resolved<T> = { readonly [K in keyof T]-?: T[K] }; type SettingsPatch = Partial<Omit<Settings, "userId">>; type PublicSettings = Omit<Resolved<Settings>, "apiToken">; and in applyPatch: const defined = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(patch).filter(([, value]) => value !== undefined)); return { ...settings, ...defined };
